{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Sheath dress, fit-and-flare silhouette, midi length, emerald green #046307, silk satin
Strappy heels, stiletto pump, high heel, metallic gold #FFD700, patent leather
Pearl drop earrings, round stud design, medium length, white pearl #FFFFFF, cultured freshwater pearl
Clutch bag, rectangular shape, small size, soft pink #FFC0CB, suede

This outfit works because the emerald green silk sheath dress exudes the elegance and grace required for a formal autumn wedding at an upscale restaurant. The metallic gold heels provide a sophisticated sparkle that complements the evening artificial lighting while adding necessary height to the ensemble. Delicate pearl earrings offer a timeless touch of classic luxury without overwhelming the rich color of the gown, creating a balanced and polished look perfect for celebrating with close friends."}
